scenario_description: A worker reports a deletion as COMPLETE, but a data flow that mirrors a user profile to an archive is still active, so deleted data can be recreated.
rationale: This removes the recreation path first.

scenario_description: A support attachment still carries a historical identifier for the same subject, even though the case was reported COMPLETE.
rationale: The attachment is a direct copy of the affected person and cannot remain.

scenario_description: The person asks for an information/correction/access request rather than deletion.
rationale: The request does not authorize deletion, so no remediation or verification is planned.
